title: Day Seven: The First Hands (Ngày 7: Những bàn tay đầu tiên)
location: Hang của bộ lạc buổi sáng sau lũ: nền hang phủ bùn và cành gãy, vệt nước còn in trên chân vách, nhưng vách đá giữa hang khô ráo dưới vệt nắng sớm chiếu qua cửa hang; măng đá hình voi ma mút, bếp lửa mới nhóm, một vỏ sò lớn đựng bột son đỏ, một ống sậy rỗng.
axis: Ở 19.1 máy quay đứng trên mỏm đá trước hang cao nhìn ra thung lũng: vách đá bên trái, mép mỏm đá và thung lũng phủ bùn phía dưới bên phải, đỉnh núi tuyết hồng ở xa, bộ lạc đứng dọc vách phía sau; từ 19.2 máy quay đứng trong hang lớn nhìn vào vách đá trơn giữa hang: vệt nắng sớm rọi xuống vách từ cửa hang bên trái, măng đá hình voi ma mút bên phải, bếp lửa mới nhóm ở tiền cảnh, Grandma Moon quỳ bên bếp.
props: Đôi tay phồng rộp của Leo, đai đeo ngực trống không còn camera, chuỗi vỏ sò và sừng lửa của Grandma Moon, vỏ sò lớn đựng bột son đỏ và hòn đá nghiền, ống sậy rỗng, vách đá khô giữa hang dưới vệt nắng sớm, hai dấu bàn tay đỏ mới in (một to, một nhỏ hơn ngay cạnh), bếp lửa mới nhóm, bùn và cành gãy trên nền hang, vệt nước trên chân vách.
setting: The large Ice Age clan cave the morning after the flood: mud and broken branches on the floor, a waterline stain along the lower walls, the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, the bare dry rock wall in the middle lit by a shaft of early sunlight, a freshly lit hearth, a large shell holding red-ochre powder and a hollow reed tube.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: The water came, as you said. The fire lives. The people live. Not one of us is lost.
turns.tone: slow and solemn, quiet relief under every word

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Because your hunter believed us. And a boy who refused to let the fire die.
turns.tone: moved and humble, voice thick with feeling

clips.setting: Clear pink dawn after the flood, seen from the rock ledge high on the limestone cliff: the valley below covered in mud, stranded ice blocks and fallen trees, the river back in its bed, mist rising, snowy peaks glowing.

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a torn mud-stained red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera

clips.sfx: a soft dawn wind over the cliff, water dripping from the rock, meltwater trickling far below in the valley, crows calling in the distance, furs rustling as people shift on the ledge

steps: @Moon stands at the edge of the rock ledge high on the cliff, looking down at the mud-covered valley in the pink dawn, and is already speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps talking slowly in her low husky voice, her pale eyes moving over the stranded ice blocks and fallen trees below.
Behind @Moon the clan in furs stands along the ledge in soft focus as she goes on, mist rising from the valley floor.
@Moon lifts her weathered hand toward the river running back in its bed as she keeps speaking, her white braid stirring in the breeze.
@Moon turns from the valley toward the people behind her and goes on slowly, the pink light warm on her lined face.
@Moon keeps talking, her voice heavy and calm, the red-ochre dot on her forehead catching the first sun.
@Moon turns to @Leo beside her and takes both of his blistered hands in hers as she keeps speaking.
@Moon says the last words slowly, turning his palms up to look at the blisters, then closes her mouth.
@Leo looks down at their joined hands, swallows and starts speaking at an even pace, his voice thick and low.
@Leo keeps talking, glancing back over his shoulder toward the clan in soft focus along the ledge, his eyes wet.
@Leo goes on, his grey-blue eyes returning to @Moon, his short sandy beard flecked with dried mud.
@Leo keeps speaking softly, his blistered fingers closing gently around her weathered hands.
@Leo's voice drops low and honest as he goes on, a tear running into his beard, the pink dawn on his face.
@Leo says the last words, closes his mouth and bows his head over their joined hands.
@Moon and @Leo stand hand in hand on the ledge, both mouths closed, as the clan behind them watches the sun rise over the peaks.
clips._hinh: Bình minh hồng trên thung lũng sau lũ: nước đã rút, bùn và băng vỡ phủ khắp lòng sông. Grandma Moon đứng trước cả bộ lạc trên mỏm đá, nhìn xuống, rồi quay sang Leo, nắm lấy hai bàn tay phồng rộp của anh.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: From today, a new law. Whoever saves the clan leaves a hand on the stone. So the children's children remember.
turns.tone: slow and ceremonial, every word a law

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: On this wall, Grandmother? Right here, in the middle, where the light falls?
turns.tone: soft and wondering, a little breathless

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: the new hearth fire crackling, a smooth stone grinding powder in a shell, water dripping from the stained lower walls, boots squelching in mud on the cave floor, birdsong from the cave mouth

steps: @Moon kneels beside the freshly lit hearth, grinding red-ochre powder in a large shell with a smooth round stone, and is already speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, her weathered hand circling the stone through the bright red powder, her braid over one shoulder.
@Moon taps the stone on the rim of the shell as she goes on, a little red dust rising into the firelight.
@Moon lifts her pale eyes to the bare dry rock wall in the middle of the cave as she keeps speaking.
@Moon keeps speaking in her low husky voice, a shaft of early sunlight falling across the wall behind her, her jaw firm.
@Moon picks up the hollow reed tube from beside the shell and goes on slowly, turning it in her fingers.
@Moon holds the reed tube out toward @Mia as she keeps talking, weighing each word like a law.
@Moon says the last words slowly, red powder still on her fingertips, her pale eyes on @Mia.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, while @Mia, kneeling opposite her, takes the hollow reed tube in both hands.
@Mia looks from the tube to the wall and starts speaking at an even pace, her green eyes wide under the cream beanie.
@Mia rises and keeps talking, the reed tube in one hand, stepping over the mud and broken branches on the cave floor.
@Mia walks toward the bare rock wall in the middle of the cave as she goes on, glancing back at @Moon.
@Mia stops in the shaft of early sunlight and lays her free palm on the dry stone as she keeps asking, half turned toward the hearth.
@Mia asks the last question looking back over her shoulder at @Moon, then closes her mouth.
@Mia stands in the warm shaft of sunlight with her palm flat on the bare wall, mouth closed, while @Moon nods once by the hearth.
clips._hinh: Trong hang đã dọn bùn, Grandma Moon nghiền bột son đỏ trong vỏ sò, trao ống sậy cho Mia. Mia bước tới vách đá trơn giữa hang, nơi vệt nắng sớm rọi xuống.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Mia, look at it. A big hand, and a smaller one right beside it. The same two we touched that night.
turns.tone: slow and hushed, stunned, almost a whisper

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: It's us. It was always us, Leo. For twenty-seven thousand years.
turns.tone: tearful and soft, quietly certain

steps: @Mia blows a soft cloud of red-ochre powder through the hollow reed tube around their two hands pressed side by side, while @Leo is already speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking in a hushed voice as @Mia lowers the reed tube and the red dust settles on the sunlit stone.
@Leo and @Mia slowly lift their hands away from the wall together, and @Leo goes on talking, his voice catching.
On the wall a big red hand stencil and a slightly smaller one appear side by side, and @Leo stares at them, still speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking, his grey-blue eyes moving from the big red hand to the smaller one right beside it.
@Leo lifts his blistered hand and holds it just above the big red hand, matching it exactly, as he goes on.
@Leo keeps speaking slowly, standing with @Mia before the two red hands in the shaft of early sunlight.
@Leo turns his head toward @Mia as he goes on, his voice dropping low, red powder still on his fingers.
@Leo says the last words, closes his mouth and looks at @Mia, breathing slowly.
@Mia's eyes fill with tears as she starts speaking at an even pace, her voice catching, her gaze on the two red hands.
@Mia keeps talking, her red-dusted fingers curling at her side, her chin trembling.
@Mia turns from the wall to @Leo as she goes on, a tear sliding down her freckled cheek.
@Mia keeps speaking softly, a small wet laugh in her voice, her green eyes locked on his.
@Mia says the last words in a whisper and closes her mouth, while @Leo gazes back at her with his mouth closed.
@Leo and @Mia stand face to face before the big red hand and the smaller one, both silent, the sunlight on their faces.
clips._hinh: Leo và Mia áp hai bàn tay cạnh nhau lên vách đá; Mia thổi bột son qua ống sậy phủ quanh tay. Hai người nhấc tay ra: trên vách hiện hai bàn tay viền đỏ, một to, một nhỏ hơn ngay cạnh, đúng như trong hang ngày nay. Hai người nhìn nhau, sững sờ.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: I should have said this three years ago. I'm in love with you.
turns.tone: slow and trembling, completely sincere

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: I know. You're a terrible actor, Leo, when it really counts.
turns.tone: dry and teasing, smiling through tears

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Can I kiss you, or is that against cave law?
turns.tone: fast and shy, laughing under his breath

steps: @Leo takes @Mia's red-dusted hand in his blistered one before the two red hands on the wall and is already speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, his thumb moving over her knuckles, his grey-blue eyes steady on hers.
@Leo draws a deep breath and goes on, the shaft of early sunlight falling across both their faces.
@Leo keeps speaking, his voice dropping low and honest, his face open and serious.
@Leo says the last words very softly, his jaw trembling a little, still holding her hand.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, swallowing hard, while @Mia looks at him with her mouth closed.
@Mia's dry half-smile spreads slowly across her freckled face as she starts speaking at an even pace.
@Mia keeps talking, tilting her head at him, her green eyes shining with tears and amusement.
@Mia gives his hand a squeeze as she goes on, her teasing tone softening.
@Mia keeps talking with a small wet laugh, her free hand resting flat on @Leo's chest.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, smiling, as @Leo breaks into a lopsided grin and starts speaking fast.

@Leo asks the last words and closes his mouth, and @Mia, mouth closed, gives one small nod.
@Mia and @Leo lean in and share one gentle, silent, closed-mouth kiss, then rest their foreheads together while the clan cheers behind them in soft focus.
clips._hinh: Hai người đứng trước hai bàn tay đỏ trên vách, ánh nắng sớm trên mặt. Leo nắm tay Mia. Câu cuối, Mia gật đầu; hai người hôn nhau nhẹ nhàng, trán chạm trán. Quần chúng trong hang reo hò, vỗ tay.

title: Pebble's Seeing Stone (Hòn đá biết nhìn của Pebble)
location: Bãi cỏ khô ven sông dưới hang buổi trưa sau lũ: nắng vàng ấm, nước sông đã trong lại, bùn khô nứt nẻ, một hình nộm tuần lộc bện bằng cỏ khô dựng làm bia tập ném.
axis: Ở 20.1–20.2 máy quay đứng trên bãi cỏ khô ven sông nhìn ngang: dòng sông trong chảy từ trái sang phải ở hậu cảnh, hình nộm tuần lộc bện cỏ ở bên phải xa, vách đá có hang của bộ lạc phía trên bên trái; ở 20.3 máy quay trong hang nhìn thẳng vào vách có hai bàn tay đỏ, bếp lửa ở tiền cảnh bên trái; ở 20.4 máy quay đứng trong hang nhìn ra cửa hang, Grandma Moon bên trái, Mia bên phải, núi tuyết và mây giông ở xa phía sau.
props: Hòn đá xám dẹt có lỗ xâu dây da trên ngực Pebble, bộ khoan cung (cung, que khoan, đế gỗ, bùi nhùi), khói mỏng, ống phóng giáo bằng gỗ và một ngọn giáo dài mũi đá lửa, gậy gỗ và nẹp chân buộc khăn đỏ của Roar, hình nộm tuần lộc bện cỏ khô, que than vẽ, hai bàn tay đỏ son trên vách, chuỗi vỏ sò biển của Grandma Moon, mây giông và chớp không tiếng ở xa.
setting: A dry grassy riverbank below the clan cave at midday after the flood: warm golden sunshine, the river running clear again, cracked dry mud, a reindeer-shaped target woven from dry grass standing on the bank.

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: Hello everyone! Today I show you how to make fire with a bow! I can survive anywhere!
turns.tone: a bright TV-host imitation, fast and proud

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Hey, that's my line! You stole my whole show. And honestly, you do it better.
turns.tone: laughing, warm and amazed

wardrobe.@Pebble: a small knee-length tunic of sewn hide with a fur hood covering both shoulders, hide leggings, a string of pierced snail shells around one wrist, a flat grey stone with a hole hanging on a leather cord on his chest, fur-wrapped feet

clips.sfx: a bow drill whirring and squeaking on wood, a clear river running over stones, warm wind in dry grass, a small boy panting, a man laughing

steps: On the sunny riverbank @Pebble kneels by a bow drill, holds the flat grey stone on his chest up toward his face and is already talking fast.
@Pebble keeps talking quickly into the stone with a huge showman's grin, one small arm flung wide like a TV host.
@Pebble lets the stone drop back on its cord and saws the bow back and forth as he keeps talking, one fur-wrapped foot on the board.
@Pebble keeps sawing the bow fast as he goes on, a thin thread of grey smoke curling up from the spindle.
@Pebble glances down at the stone on his chest as if into a lens and keeps talking, his eyebrows bouncing.
@Pebble shouts the last words, puffing out his small chest, then closes his mouth with a proud nod.
@Leo, crouching beside him, bursts out laughing and starts speaking, pointing at the stone on @Pebble's chest.
@Leo keeps talking through his laughter, patting his own empty chest harness in mock outrage.
@Leo shakes his head and goes on, wiping a laughing tear from his eye with the back of his blistered hand.
@Leo keeps talking, ruffling @Pebble's messy mop of brown hair with one hand, his grin wide.
@Leo leans in toward @Pebble as he says the last words, his voice dropping into honest admiration.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, still grinning, while @Pebble beams up at him with his mouth closed.
@Pebble bends back over the bow drill, mouth closed, sawing hard, and a thicker curl of grey smoke rises.
@Leo leans close to watch the smoke with his lips pressed together, while @Pebble keeps sawing in silence.
@Pebble and @Leo crouch over the smoking bow drill on the sunny riverbank, both silent, the woven-grass reindeer target standing behind them.
clips._hinh: Pebble đeo trước ngực một hòn đá xám dẹt có lỗ, xâu dây da, giống hệt chiếc camera ngực của Leo. Cậu nói vào hòn đá như đang quay vlog, tay kéo bộ khoan cung, khói bốc lên. Leo ngồi xổm cạnh, cười ngặt nghẽo.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Like this, brother. The thrower is a longer arm. Let your whole body throw, not just your hand.
turns.tone: gruff and patient, a teacher for once

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: I hit it! I actually hit it! Did you see that? First try!
turns.tone: fast and ecstatic, almost squeaking

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Now you are a hunter.
turns.tone: slow and proud, deep and warm

steps: @Roar leans on his wooden staff, his splinted ankle bound with the red bandana, and is already speaking as he places the spear-thrower in @Leo's hand.
@Roar keeps talking in his deep rough voice, closing @Leo's blistered fingers around the hooked end of the wooden thrower.
@Roar fits the butt of a long flint-tipped spear into the hook of the thrower as he goes on, gruff and patient.
@Roar stretches his own arm out long beside @Leo's as he keeps talking, showing how the thrower adds reach.
@Roar turns @Leo's hips side-on to the target with his free hand as he goes on, his heavy brows low.
@Roar nods toward the woven-grass reindeer target down the bank and keeps talking, his jaw set.
@Leo swings his whole body forward and the spear flies from the thrower across the grass, as @Roar says the last words.
The spear sinks into the woven-grass target with a dry thud as @Roar closes his mouth and @Leo starts shouting fast.
@Leo jumps straight up with both arms in the air, shouting fast, his reindeer-hide cape flapping.
@Leo keeps shouting, pointing wildly at the spear standing in the grass target, his grin enormous.
@Leo spins toward @Roar as he goes on, bouncing on his toes, both fists clenched by his chest.
@Leo shouts the last words breathlessly and closes his mouth, panting, his eyes shining at @Roar.
@Roar limps one step closer on his staff and starts speaking slowly, his heavy brows lifting in approval.
@Roar keeps speaking as he claps one big hand down on @Leo's shoulder, nodding once.
@Roar says the last words and closes his mouth, his hand still on @Leo's shoulder, while @Leo stands tall with his mouth closed.
clips._hinh: Roar chống gậy, chân nẹp, đặt ống phóng giáo vào tay Leo, chỉ cách giữ. Leo vung cả người ném; ngọn giáo cắm phập vào hình nộm cỏ. Leo nhảy cẫng lên; Roar gật đầu, đập tay lên vai anh.

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: I draw you two holding hands. And the seeing stone on Fire's chest, so it is not lost forever.
turns.tone: careful and earnest, concentrating

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: It's perfect. Now we'll never be lost. Not even in twenty-seven thousand years.
turns.tone: slow and tender, close to tears

@Pebble keeps talking as he draws a round head and a straight body, a first stick figure next to the big red hand.
@Pebble glances at @Mia kneeling beside him and goes on, drawing a second, smaller stick figure beside the first.
@Pebble joins the two stick figures with one short line between their arms, holding hands, as he keeps talking.
@Pebble keeps talking, his brow knotted in concentration, and draws a small square box on the bigger figure's chest.
@Pebble taps the little square box twice with the charcoal as he goes on, his big dark eyes serious.
@Pebble presses one hand to the flat grey stone on his own chest as he keeps talking, his voice dropping.
@Pebble says the last words and closes his mouth, while @Mia lays her hand on his small shoulder and starts speaking slowly.
@Mia keeps talking slowly, her eyes welling as she looks from the drawing to the boy, her voice soft.

@Mia keeps speaking softly, gazing at the two stick figures holding hands beside the two red hands.

@Mia keeps talking slowly as a tear rolls down her freckled cheek, her other hand touching the bare rock beside the drawing.

clips._hinh: Trong hang, Pebble cầm que than vẽ lên vách đá ngay cạnh hai bàn tay đỏ: hai hình người que nắm tay nhau, một người có ô vuông trên ngực. Mia quỳ cạnh cậu bé, đặt tay lên vai cậu, mắt rưng rưng.

steps: At the mouth of the cave @Moon lifts the necklace of pierced sea shells from around her own neck and is already speaking slowly.

title: Storm on the Seventh Evening (Giông chiều thứ bảy)
location: Hang của bộ lạc trong đêm giông: ngoài cửa hang mưa như trút, chớp trắng loá liên hồi; măng đá hình voi ma mút, bếp lửa cháy đỏ; giữa vách đá là hai bàn tay đỏ son, một to, một nhỏ, bên cạnh là hình vẽ than hai người que nắm tay nhau.
axis: Máy quay đứng trong hang, lưng quay về bếp lửa, nhìn thẳng vào vách đá giữa hang: hai bàn tay đỏ và hình vẽ than hai người que ở giữa vách, cửa hang rộng với mưa và chớp trắng ở bên trái, măng đá hình voi ma mút bên phải, bộ lạc đứng lùi trong bóng tối phía sau bếp lửa.
props: Hai bàn tay đỏ son trên vách ấm sáng mờ mỗi lần chớp và rực lên ở 21.4, hình vẽ than hai người que nắm tay, chuỗi vỏ sò biển trên cổ Mia, gậy gỗ và nẹp chân buộc khăn đỏ của Roar, vòng răng thú của Roar, hòn đá xám dẹt có lỗ trên ngực Pebble, đai đeo ngực trống của Leo, bếp lửa đỏ, mưa trút ngoài cửa hang.
setting: A storm at night inside the large Ice Age clan cave: white lightning flashing through the wide mouth onto the rock wall with two red-ochre hand stencils side by side and, beside them, a charcoal drawing of two stick figures holding hands, the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, a hearth fire, the clan standing back in the shadows.

turns.speaker: @Mia

steps: @Mia stands before the rock wall in the storm night, a white flash lighting the two red hands, and is already speaking slowly, her breath shaky.
@Mia keeps talking slowly as the two red hand stencils give off a faint warm glow with the lightning.
@Mia lifts her palm and holds it just above the smaller red hand as she goes on, her fingers trembling.
@Mia keeps speaking, feeling the warmth on her skin, her green eyes wide in the flickering white light.
@Mia draws her hand back a little and goes on, the sea shells at her collar rising and falling with her breath.
@Mia turns from the glowing wall to @Leo as she keeps talking, rain hammering beyond the cave mouth.
@Mia looks searchingly into his face as she goes on, her voice catching on the question.
@Mia asks the last words slowly and closes her mouth, her lips pressed together, waiting.
@Leo takes her trembling hand in his blistered one and starts speaking at an even pace, his eyes steady.
@Leo keeps talking, lacing his fingers through hers as another flash makes the red hands glow behind them.
@Leo steps closer as he goes on, his voice low and sure, a gust from the cave mouth tugging at his cape.
@Leo keeps speaking, lifting their joined hands slightly between them, his grey-blue eyes on hers.
@Leo says the last words with a small firm nod, his thumb pressing her knuckles.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, and @Mia, mouth closed, lets out a long shaky breath.
@Mia and @Leo stand hand in hand before the faintly glowing red hands, both silent, as white lightning flashes through the cave mouth.
clips._hinh: Mia và Leo đứng trước vách, hai bàn tay đỏ son trên vách phát ánh ấm mờ mờ mỗi khi chớp loé. Mia đặt tay gần vách, cảm nhận hơi ấm, rồi quay sang Leo.

turns.tone: teasing and warm, voice wobbling

title: Return (Trở về)
time_label: Rạng sáng, hang Bàn Tay ngày nay (21:00–22:00)
location: Hang đá vôi ở Pyrenees ngày nay lúc rạng sáng sau giông: cửa hang vòm, măng đá hình voi ma mút, hàng trăm dấu bàn tay đỏ son đã mờ trên vách, giữa vách là một bàn tay to và một bàn tay nhỏ hơn ngay cạnh; ánh đèn pin của đội cứu hộ quét vào từ cửa hang.
axis: Ở 22.1–22.2 máy quay đứng trên nền hang nhìn về phía cửa hang vòm: Leo và Mia nằm rồi ngồi dưới chân vách bàn tay ở bên phải, cửa hang với rừng thu và chùm đèn pin của đội cứu hộ ở bên trái; ở 22.3–22.4 máy quay đặt sát cửa hang nhìn ra thung lũng mùa thu, vách hang ở phía sau lưng nhân vật, đường cáp treo xa xa bên phải.
props: Vách hàng trăm dấu bàn tay đỏ đã mờ, bàn tay to và bàn tay nhỏ ở giữa vách, chùm đèn pin trong bụi sáng, dây cứu hộ trên nền hang, áo phản quang và mũ bảo hộ của nhân viên cứu hộ, cáng cứu thương và chăn cứu hộ bạc, chuỗi vỏ sò trên cổ Mia, đai đeo ngực trống của Leo, đôi tay phồng rộp chai sạn của Leo, chiếc gimbal của Mia nằm trên nền hang (màn hình chỉ phát sáng), đường cáp treo xa xa.
setting: Early morning inside the same large limestone cave in the Pyrenees today after the storm: the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, the wall of hundreds of faded red-ochre hand stencils with one bigger hand in the middle and a slightly smaller hand right beside it, rescue ropes on the floor, flashlight beams in the dusty air, autumn forest beyond the mouth.

title: The Video With No Acting (Video không diễn)
time_label: Một tuần sau, hiên nhà gỗ (22:00–23:00)
location: Hiên nhà gỗ chalet ở chân núi Pyrenees ngày nay, chiều thu: lá vàng, núi xa, một bếp lửa nhỏ trong vòng đá trên sân, chiếc điện thoại gắn trên chân máy ba chân quay về phía hiên.
axis: Máy quay đứng trên bãi cỏ nhìn về phía hiên nhà gỗ: bậc hiên ở giữa, vòng đá có bếp lửa nhỏ ở tiền cảnh bên trái, điện thoại trên chân máy nhỏ ở tiền cảnh bên phải quay về phía bậc hiên, rặng núi đá rực nắng chiều ở xa phía sau bên trái; ở 23.3–23.4 hai người ngồi sát nhau bên bếp lửa, hiên nhà ở phía sau.
props: Điện thoại gắn trên chân máy ba chân nhỏ (màn hình chỉ phát sáng, không chữ), bậc hiên gỗ cũ, lá vàng, vòng đá có bếp lửa nhỏ, bộ khoan cung tự làm (cung, que khoan, đế gỗ, bùi nhùi khô), đốm than đỏ, phong bì gấp đôi trơn không chữ của Mia, chiếc bật lửa nhỏ, chuỗi vỏ sò trên cổ Mia, đôi tay chai sạn của Leo.
setting: The wooden porch of a mountain chalet at the forest edge in the Pyrenees today, autumn evening at golden dusk: worn plank steps, golden leaves, a small fire in a stone ring on the lawn, a smartphone on a small tripod, rocky peaks glowing in the distance.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Hello everyone. For three years, I lied to you. I can't survive anywhere. Every fire you saw, she lit.
turns.tone: slow and honest, no showman in it

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Until a week ago. Now he lights them all himself. With a bow drill.
turns.tone: even and warm, quietly proud

@Leo keeps speaking, lifting one hand toward the small fire in the stone ring on the lawn.
@Leo turns his head and looks at @Mia beside him as he goes on, his face softening.
@Leo keeps talking with his eyes on @Mia, a small rueful smile at the corner of his mouth.

title: Fire-Makers (Những người giữ lửa)
time_label: Ban ngày, hang Bàn Tay ngày nay (23:00–24:00)
location: Hang đá vôi ở Pyrenees ngày nay, ban ngày, trời quang: nắng chiếu qua cửa hang vòm, măng đá hình voi ma mút, hàng trăm bàn tay đỏ son mờ trên vách; ngay cạnh bàn tay to và bàn tay nhỏ ở giữa vách là hai hình người que vẽ than đã mờ, nắm tay nhau, một người có ô vuông trên ngực.
axis: Máy quay đứng giữa hang nhìn vào vách đá: vách hàng trăm bàn tay đỏ mờ ở giữa khung, bàn tay to và bàn tay nhỏ ở trung tâm, hình vẽ than hai người que ngay bên phải hai bàn tay, cửa hang vòm đầy nắng ở bên trái, măng đá hình voi ma mút bên phải; ở 24.4 cắt xen cùng hướng nhìn giữa hang ban ngày hôm nay và hang ban đêm thời băng hà với bếp lửa ở tiền cảnh.
props: Đèn pin của Mia, vách bàn tay đỏ mờ, hình vẽ than đã mờ hai người que nắm tay (một người có ô vuông trên ngực), chuỗi vỏ sò trên cổ Mia, điện thoại của Mia và của Leo (màn hình chỉ phát sáng); thời băng hà ở 24.4: hòn đá xám dẹt có lỗ trên ngực Pebble, bộ khoan cung, bếp lửa, hai bàn tay đỏ son còn tươi.
setting: Daytime inside the same large limestone cave in the Pyrenees today: sunlight slanting through the wide arched mouth onto the mammoth-shaped stalagmite and the wall of hundreds of faded red-ochre hand stencils, the bigger hand in the middle with a smaller hand beside it, and next to them a faint old charcoal drawing of two stick figures holding hands, one with a small square box on its chest.

turns.tone: a slow awed whisper

turns.line: The seeing stone. Pebble drew us. Twenty-seven thousand years, and he kept us together.
turns.tone: moved, voice rough with tears

@Mia keeps whispering, her free hand rising to the sea-shell necklace at her collar, her eyes wide.
@Mia turns her head toward @Leo as she goes on, her voice catching, the flashlight steady on the drawing.
@Mia says the last words in a whisper and closes her mouth, her lips trembling.
@Leo steps up beside @Mia, stares at the faint drawing and starts speaking at an even pace, his voice rough.
@Leo keeps talking, his grey-blue eyes moving from the little square box to the two red hands beside it.
@Leo lets out a short disbelieving laugh as he goes on, shaking his head slowly.
@Leo keeps talking, his eyes filling with tears, the flashlight beam lighting his face from below.
@Leo raises his hand toward the charcoal drawing as he says the last words, his voice breaking.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, and his fingertip barely touches the faint line of the figure with the square box.
@Leo's fingertip rests on the old charcoal line beside the faded red hands, mouth closed, while @Mia's beam holds steady on the drawing.
clips._hinh: Mia rọi đèn pin lên vách cạnh hai bàn tay, phát hiện hình vẽ than mờ: hai người que nắm tay nhau, một người có ô vuông trên ngực. Leo bước tới, nhìn sững, đưa tay chạm khẽ vào nét than.

turns.line: Do you think he kept his promise? The fire alive, every single night?
turns.tone: soft and wondering, an even pace

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: I know he did. That kid could survive anywhere. Better than I ever pretended to.
turns.tone: slow and fond, smiling

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Then let's keep our promise too.
turns.tone: warm and decided

@Mia tilts her head back against the rock as she goes on, sunlight from the cave mouth falling across her knees.
@Mia keeps speaking softly, rubbing the shell with her thumb, her brow faintly creased.
@Mia keeps talking, turning to look at @Leo beside her, her voice quiet.

@Leo keeps talking slowly, his eyes on the little figure with the square box, a tender smile in his beard.

@Leo keeps speaking, reaching down and taking @Mia's hand in his calloused one on the cave floor.
@Leo goes on with a small rueful laugh, shaking his head at himself, his thumb stroking her knuckles.
@Leo keeps talking softly, looking back up at the charcoal drawing, his eyes shining.
@Leo says the last words and closes his mouth, squeezing her hand, his gaze on the two stick figures.

clips._hinh: Hai người ngồi bệt dưới vách, vai tựa vai, ngước nhìn hình vẽ. Mia mân mê chuỗi vỏ sò trên cổ; Leo nắm tay cô.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Nothing. No lightning. Good. I'd like to stay in this century, here with you, if that's okay.
turns.tone: relieved and laughing, warm

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Then say it, Leo. You promised a little boy, remember?

steps: @Leo and @Mia press their palms onto the two faded red hands on the wall, and @Leo, eyes squeezed shut, is already speaking at an even pace.
@Leo keeps talking, opening one eye, then the other, his palm still flat on the big faded hand.
@Leo glances at the sunlit cave mouth as he goes on, the sky beyond bright, clear and still.
@Leo lets out a long breath of relief and keeps talking, a laugh bubbling into his voice.
@Leo lifts his hand from the wall and turns to @Mia as he goes on, grinning.
@Leo keeps talking with a soft grin, his eyes on hers, his calloused hand finding hers.
@Leo says the last words a little shyly and closes his mouth, his head tilted.
@Mia pulls her phone from the back pocket of her jeans, lifts it with its screen glowing and starts speaking fast.
@Mia keeps talking quickly, holding the phone up to film @Leo, its glow lighting her freckled face.
@Mia says the last words with a teasing nod toward the wall, then closes her mouth behind the phone.
@Leo straightens, looks straight into the lens of @Mia's phone and starts speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly into the lens, no showman's grin, just a small honest smile.
@Leo says the last words softly, lifting one hand in a small wave toward the phone, then closes his mouth.
@Leo keeps his hand raised in the small wave, mouth closed, as @Mia keeps filming him.

clips._hinh: Leo và Mia cùng đặt tay lên hai bàn tay đỏ trên vách. Không có gì xảy ra; ngoài cửa hang trời vẫn quang. Leo thở phào, cười. Mia giơ điện thoại lên quay; Leo quay mặt về phía ống kính.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: I can't survive anywhere. Nobody can. I survived because she held my hand, and never let go.
turns.tone: slow and plain, a confession to the lens

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: Hello everyone! Today I teach you how to make fire with a bow! I can survive anywhere!
turns.tone: a bright proud TV-host shout

clips.setting: The same limestone cave with the mammoth-shaped stalagmite in two times: today in bright daylight with the wall of faded red hand stencils, and about twenty-seven thousand years ago at night, lit by a hearth fire with children of the clan sitting around it and two fresh red hand stencils on the wall.

wardrobe.@Pebble: a small knee-length tunic of sewn hide with a fur hood covering both shoulders, hide leggings, a string of pierced snail shells around one wrist, a flat grey stone with a hole hanging on a leather cord on his chest, fur-wrapped feet

steps: Today in the sunlit cave @Leo holds a phone up at arm's length and is already speaking slowly, a woman's hand in a cream knit sleeve holding his.
@Leo keeps talking slowly into the phone, no grin, the faded red hand stencils soft on the wall behind him.
@Leo glances down at the woman's hand holding his as he goes on, his thumb moving over her knuckles.
@Leo keeps speaking, lifting their joined hands a little so the phone can see them, his voice low.
@Leo looks back into the phone as he goes on, his grey-blue eyes wet in the sunlight.
@Leo keeps speaking slowly, a small honest smile tugging at the corner of his mouth.
@Leo says the last words, tightening his hold on the woman's hand, his chin lifting.
In the same cave by night long ago, @Pebble kneels by the hearth with the flat grey stone on his chest and starts shouting fast, as @Leo's last words fade.
@Pebble saws the bow of a bow drill back and forth over a wooden board, still shouting, a few clan children in fur hoods watching around the hearth.
@Pebble keeps shouting proudly, lifting the flat grey stone on his chest toward his face like a TV host.
@Pebble grins at the children as he goes on, sawing faster, a thick curl of smoke rising from the spindle.
@Pebble keeps shouting, flinging one small arm wide as a glowing ember drops into the dry tinder.
@Pebble shouts the last words and closes his mouth as the tinder bursts into a bright flame and the children clap.
On the rock wall the two red hands, a big one and a smaller one, sit side by side in the flickering firelight of long ago, silent.
The firelight on the two red hands slowly fades, silent, until only their faint red outlines remain in the dark.
clips._hinh: Cắt xen hai thời. Hôm nay: Leo nói vào điện thoại, một bàn tay phụ nữ nắm tay anh trong khung hình. 27.000 năm trước: trong cùng cái hang, bên bếp lửa, Pebble đeo hòn đá dẹt trên ngực, kéo bộ khoan cung trước một nhóm trẻ con, khói bốc lên, lửa bùng. Hai hình ảnh chồng lên nhau rồi khung hình tối dần.
